subject: ielts
title: Education
summary: 20 академических слов и коллокаций про образование для Writing Task 2 и Speaking.
theory:
## Как учить этот набор
Тема Education встречается в IELTS чаще всех остальных: в Writing Task 2, в Speaking Part 1 и 3, в Reading. Не заучивай перевод — заучивай **коллокацию** (слово + его обычные соседи): не просто *curriculum*, а *the school curriculum*, *curriculum reform*.

Порядок работы: 10 новых слов за один вечер → на следующий день повторение по карточкам → в конце недели напиши 3 предложения о своей школе с пятью новыми словами. Слово считается выученным, когда ты можешь употребить его в своём предложении, а не только узнать в тексте.

words.def: the subjects that are taught in a school or college
words.example: Coding was added to the school curriculum three years ago.

words.def: the money students pay for their courses
words.example: Tuition fees at private universities have risen sharply.

words.def: connected with training for a particular job or skill
words.example: Vocational training gives students practical skills employers need.

words.def: the ability to read and write
words.example: Adult literacy rates have improved across the region.

words.def: to officially join a course or school
words.example: Over four thousand students enrolled in the online programme.

words.def: money given to a student to pay for their studies
words.example: She won a full scholarship to study engineering abroad.

words.def: the process of judging a student's level or progress
words.example: Continuous assessment is fairer than a single final exam.

words.def: learning by repeating something until you remember it, without understanding
words.example: Rote learning helps with vocabulary but not with problem solving.

words.def: the ability to analyse information and judge it carefully
words.example: Debating clubs develop critical thinking far better than textbooks.

words.def: that must be done because of a rule or law
words.example: Secondary education is compulsory until the age of sixteen.

words.def: a university student who has not yet taken a first degree
words.example: Most undergraduates take four years to complete their degree.

words.def: to leave school or university before finishing
words.example: Financial pressure forces some students to drop out.

words.def: buildings and equipment provided for a particular purpose
words.example: Rural schools often lack laboratory facilities.

words.def: made or changed to suit particular needs
words.example: Online platforms offer lessons tailored to each learner's level.

words.def: continuing to study and learn new skills throughout life
words.example: Rapid technological change makes lifelong learning essential.

words.def: the influence that people of your own age have on your behaviour
words.example: Peer pressure can push teenagers to skip lessons.

words.def: the level of achievement a student reaches
words.example: Educational attainment strongly affects future earnings.

words.def: to make someone want to do something
words.example: Clear goals motivate students more than punishment does.

words.def: a way of studying where lessons are delivered remotely
words.example: Distance learning allows students in remote villages to attend classes.

words.def: the amount of work a person has to do
words.example: A heavy workload leaves teenagers little time for sport.

questions.text: Choose the word that matches the definition: «the subjects that are taught in a school».
Choose the word: «money given to a student to pay for their studies».
questions.explanation: Scholarship — стипендия или грант. Tuition fees — наоборот, деньги, которые платит студент.

questions.text: Choose the word: «connected with training for a particular job or skill».
Choose the word: «that must be done because of a rule or law».
Choose the phrase: «learning by repeating something until you remember it, without understanding».
Choose the word: «to leave school or university before finishing».
questions.explanation: Drop out of university — бросить учёбу; enrol — наоборот, поступить.

questions.text: Choose the word: «the ability to read and write».
Choose the word: «the level of achievement a student reaches».
questions.explanation: Educational attainment — уровень образовательных достижений; attainment gap — разрыв в успеваемости.

questions.text: Complete the collocation: «Online courses are ______ to each learner's level».
questions.explanation: Tailored to — подобранный под чьи-то нужды.

questions.text: Choose the phrase: «the influence that people of your own age have on your behaviour».
questions.explanation: Peer pressure — давление со стороны ровесников.
